messages:
maria: Heads up — we saw a p99 latency jump right after the v8 rollout at ~03:20 UTC. p99 baseline ~420ms -> ~1.5s. Traces look like a kernel-selection flip and a KV-cache hit-rate drop. Dumping profiler snippet below.

maria: ```
[profiler] kernel_select: chosen=attn_cuda_v2 fallback=attn_generic
seq_len.p50=48 seq_len.p95=512 seq_len.p99=1024
avg_batch_size=3.2 queue_ms=120
kv_cache.hits_pct=64 kv_cache.misses_pct=36
batcher: target_batch=8 actual_batch=16 prefer_latency=false
```

sam: Was there any tokenizer change in this rollout? :eyes:

maria: Yes — tokenizer v2.3 included a rare-subtoken normalization change. For some customer traffic that increased subtokens per prompt and pushed the seq-len tail up.

liam: That would explain kernel scoring preferring attn_cuda_v2 for mid-length but misbehaving on long tails. Can we force a kernel override for seq_len>512 as a short-term mitigation?

nora: We have a routing knob to pin model-variant -> attn_generic, but that requires a light rollout and a config push. I can prepare it.

deploy-bot: Canary rollback available: `/rollout rollback v8 -> v7` (requires approvals).

maria: Trying a host-local kernel_hint=attn_generic on a small canary (hosts 20-25) and lowering max_batch_size from 16 -> 12. Early numbers: p99 dropped from 1.5s -> ~480ms on canary, KV hit% recovered to ~85% after warmup.

sam: Good. Capture perf counters and KV cache debug for the next hour. Also enable the perf-bot trace aggregation.

perf-bot: Aggregating traces for thread 1987654321. Will post p50/p95/p99 deltas and KV hit% every 5m.

maria: Plan: 1) pin kernel hint on canary + batcher cap 2) ramp canary 3) if p99 stable, promote; else revert tokenizer change for affected customers 4) add KV-prefetch warmup for requests that exceed 512 subtokens 5) follow up with load-profile test to validate kernel scoring.

liam: +1. Also add an alert for kv_cache.hits_pct drop below 80% that triggers an automatic investigation runbook.

nora: Created incident channel #inc-1987-perf and added oncall.

maria: Will update here with perf-bot numbers and a final decision. Thanks all :shipit:
